Task1 · Actual-frequency pure-sine comparison

3000/3030Hz (30Hz beat) versus9000/9090Hz (90Hz beat). Carrier and beat both change; this is not a carrier-only experiment or physiological-equivalence comparison. Same original4-square-pad geometry,2 independent outputs/common GND/50Ω; fixed D50mm and0.1/5/5/15mm layers. Values are precomputed, not recomputed by this page.

Primary ROI:r≤5mm,depth15–20mm. WholeXY at that depth is supplemental. All field tables/bars use V/m; burdens use A/m²,V RMS,W,mA. maxTIS is a2074-direction sampled maximum; fixedTIS uses(X+Y)/√2; RMS is not TIS modulation. Here both active sine carriers are included in RMS.

Calculated and unadopted. Existing SC/XY/bulk/contact convergence holds remain; no new C1 control, instrument-loaded prediction, experimental validation or safety certification. Skin/contact-only can exceed1Vpp numerically; legacy composite additionally caps source power and1Vpp. Current sum is output-RMS bookkeeping, not common-return current.

Existing37-case/4–8–12–16-pad GUI (unchanged). This new screen contains shared-axis scalar bars, not new-frequency spatial maps. Old maps must not be relabeled as these sine results.

SC4 versus SC2 · reference definitions

Erratum: Stored strings saying same-grid baseline for fixed high-volume cutoffs are inaccurate for SC4: all SC4 sine high volumes use frozen SC2 square thresholds. SC4 own thresholds were recorded separately and not used. Raw artifacts are unchanged.

SC4 own-square and fresh-SC4-sine caps are same-grid. SC2-square caps are an absolute cross-grid burden reference. The historical SC4 square row remains RAW; its own-cutoff high volumes are not displayed as SC2-threshold volumes. Original SC2 frequency GUI. No SC-convergence or frequency-matched C1 claim.
